jobs.title: Vice President, Real Estate Development (REMOTE)
jobs.description:
Location

Dallas - 2101 Cedar Springs Road, Suite 1580

Our Company

BGRE is a premier, global real estate partner to the world’s most ambitious businesses. It operates and develops the real estate they rely on to grow with conviction across markets and sectors. The company combines global scale with deep local expertise, managing more than 260 MSF of office, logistics, hospitality, retail and living space in gateway markets around the world on behalf of Brookfield. Supported by thousands of employees worldwide, BGRE is committed to building strong partnerships, operating sustainably and creating places where people can work, live, connect and thrive. For more information, visit bgre.com.

Job Description

At BGRE, we don’t just build and manage buildings. We envision and develop forward-thinking properties where businesses, people and communities thrive. From strategic planning through completion, our experienced team brings developments to life with a focus on creating enduring value and meaningful experiences.

We are seeking a VP, Real Estate Development to join BGRE in Dallas, TX/Remote. In this position, you will play a key role in helping to expand our business in one of the most dynamic multifamily markets in the U.S. — and BGRE is investing to grow with it. This is a unique opportunity to build a Texas platform from a position of real influence, backed by the scale and resources of a global real estate leader.

The development team brings together expertise across acquisition, planning, design, construction and execution to transform vision into high-performing real estate assets. The team operates with a collaborative, entrepreneurial mindset, bringing diverse perspectives together to solve complex challenges and deliver with excellence.

Role & Responsibilities:

- Source, evaluate, and lead execution of new development and acquisition opportunities across BGRE’s core Texas markets (Dallas-Fort Worth, Austin)

- Build and manage a robust pipeline of off-market and marketed development acquisition opportunities through relationships with brokers, landowners, municipalities, and capital partners

- Lead due diligence for new acquisitions, coordinating with legal, engineering, environmental, and other consultants to assess risk and feasibility

- Cultivate and expand relationships with landowners, developers, brokers, municipalities, economic development agencies, and capital partners across Texas

- Engage with our investment analysis team to develop, maintain, and present financial models and underwriting for prospective development opportunities, including DCF projections, return sensitivities, and comparable market analysis

- Represent BGRE at industry events, conferences, and local government meetings to build brand presence and generate new deal flow

- Coordinate information exchange with regional offices and cross-functional teams, including Acquisitions, Design & Construction, Leasing, Asset Management, Legal, and Marketing, to advance opportunities from sourcing through closing

- Monitor entitlement, zoning, and land use requirements; develop and maintain expertise in local regulations and trends across target Texas markets

- Assist in setting the annual business development strategy, goals, and objectives

- Develop, maintain, & report on financial models for current & prospective development projects

- Track project budgets & prepare reports for internal FP&A team; help to set project-related tasks, milestones, & meeting schedules during acquisitions, predevelopment, entitlements, & construction

- Engage with & help oversee the workflow of architects, engineers, general contractors & other consultants & service providers

Your Qualifications:

- Bachelor’s degree in real estate, finance, business, or related field; graduate degree a plus

- 10+ years of experience in commercial real estate development, acquisitions, or business development, with a demonstrated track record of sourcing and closing deals in Texas markets

- Established network of relationships with landowners, brokers, municipalities, and capital partners across Texas

- Experience managing and overseeing all aspects of a development project- Acquisition, entitlement, design, construction, lease up.

- Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel; ARGUS Enterprise experience a plus

- Strong deal-sourcing, negotiation, and relationship-building skills

- Excellent interpersonal, analytical, and strategic problem-solving abilities

- Strong written, verbal, and presentation communication skills

- Ability to lead cross-functional deal teams and work collaboratively across departments

- Ability to compellingly articulate ideas, arguments, and recommendations to senior leadership and external partners

- Ability to manage multiple opportunities simultaneously; strong organizational skills and ability to prioritize and meet deadlines

- Self-motivated and entrepreneurial, with a proactive approach to identifying and pursuing new business opportunities

- Willingness to travel throughout Texas and the greater U.S. as needed

Your Career @ BGRE:

At BGRE, your career progression is important to us. As a successful employee, you will have the opportunity to grow within your team, department, and across the Brookfield organization. Our leadership teams are dedicated to the accomplishments of their employees. We also invest time into training and developing our people.

End your job search and find your career today, at BGRE.

Why BGRE?

We imagine, create, and operate on a foundation of values to build a better world, together. BGRE strives to create spaces where going to work never feels routine. As a BGRE employee, you will enjoy many benefits such as 401K matching, tuition reimbursement, summer Fridays, paid maternity leave and more. There is also a generous employee referral program because we want our existing team members to help us build a more diverse workplace through their networks.

We are proud to create a diverse environment and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are grateful for your interest in this position, however, only candidates selected for pre-screening will be contacted.

Work alongside the Asset Management team to execute on various assignments within BGRE’s Downtown Toronto Office Portfolio (+9M square feet).

Assist with the development and executive execution of various regional initiatives, including leasing, property operations, financial management, strategic objectives – financings, acquisitions and dispositions, business planning, talent management and portfolio and property valuations.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Actively lead and support the execution of various initiatives including:
• Office & Retail Leasing – Maximize Leasing Revenue, Velocity and Term
• Capital Expenditures – Allocation & Project Execution
• Strategic Initiatives – Acquisitions, Dispositions, Financings and Portfolio Strategies
• Employee Development – Asset & Property Management Teams

• Process Improvement – Leasing, Legal, Accounting, Construction and Property Management coordination
• Fiduciary Responsibility – Cash Flow, Liquidity Analysis and Financial Statement Review
• Organizational Effectiveness – Innovation, Productivity and Efficiency

• Lead and support the completion of all tasks related to the annual Business Plan process, including development of Master & Specific Leasing Assumptions, Rental Inflation Curves, Property Operating and Capital Expense Forecasts, Expense Recovery & Shortfall Analysis, Investment Value Generation, Debt Modelling and Accretive Asset Strategies

• Develop working relationships with joint venture partners and co-owners and assist with the completion and coordination of the various external reporting requirements, presentations, and business plans
• Active involvement in the Toronto Commercial Real Estate Industry promoting both professional development and the best interests of BGRE

QUALIFICATIONS
SERVICE / PERSONAL SKILLS:

• Thrive in a fast-paced environment and be able to balance a varied workload and tight deadlines.
• Superior attention to detail, accuracy and ability to follow-up as required to meet deadlines.
• Results driven, detail orientated, balanced with strong communication and interpersonal skills to influence and drive change.
• Relationship management skills with respect to key stakeholders including co-owners, tenants, lenders, appraisers, consultants and the senior management/executive team.
• Strong leadership skills with a focus on solution-oriented approach to addressing issues with direct oversight of property management team.
• Must be a team player with exceptional work ethic and adaptability.

EXPERIENCE & TECHNICAL SKILLS:

• 8+ years of extensive and relevant exposure to commercial office real estate.
• Well-rounded understanding of commercial mixed-use office fundamentals, including office and retail leasing, DCF valuation modelling, property management, building operations, business plan development, tenant and landlord construction, capital expenditure management and value-add asset strategies.
• Detail oriented.
• Proven history of excelling within team dynamics.
• High numerical and arithmetic aptitude with a sound understanding of NPV, IRR, DCF and TVM principles.
• Strong analytical ability; able to provide meaningful conclusions and effective leadership to internal Analyst team.
• Sound communication and organizational skills; able to efficiently prioritize multiple tasks.
• Self-motivated and proactive, both with respect to managing workload and professional development.
• Confidently able to deliver results and present to Senior Leadership under tight deadlines.
• Proficient in Argus Enterprise, Yardi and Microsoft applications with Advanced Excel.

EDUCATION/DESIGNATIONS/LICENSES:

• University degree in Business, Accounting, Finance or Economics is preferred.
• Professional Financial or Commercial Real Estate designation are additionally beneficial

Our leadership teams are dedicated to the accomplishments of their employees. We also invest time into training and developing our people.

End your job search and find your career today, at BGRE.

We imagine, create, and operate on a foundation of values to build a better world, together. BGRE strives to create spaces where going to work never feels routine. As a BGRE employee, you will enjoy many benefits such as 401K matching, tuition reimbursement, summer Fridays, paid maternity leave and more. The General Manager inspires and leads the property team and collaborates across disciplines to achieve property specific business metrics and goals. This role builds strong local community relationships, champions corporate-wide initiatives and achieves operational excellence in all areas while complying with safety and health principles.

Responsibilities
- Operate a clean, well maintained property providing guests with a positive shopping experience.

- Prepare and manage multi-year ordinary capital and operating expense plans to meet or exceed company expectations.

- Strong ownership and knowledge of key metrics for the property including net operating income, cash flow, occupancy, sales, and property financing.

- Manage and develop the talent of their property team(s) while ensuring compliance with all company policies and procedures.

- Demonstrate executive leadership by guiding successful team(s) representative of the company’s core values.

- Partner with corporate departments to align on and achieve property and corporate objectives.

- Monitor and assist with accounts receivables as needed to achieve company objectives.

- Continuously align team and employee development goals with organizational goals.

MOD coverage may be defined as on call, when appropriate, and the MOD is required to be on-site at least one Saturday per month. The on-site requirements of the MOD will be determined and approved by leadership.

- Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications
- High School Diploma or GED required.

- Bachelor’s degree preferred.

- Master’s degree in a related field is a plus.

- 5+ years of shopping center leadership experience required.

- Strong leadership, interpersonal and relationship building skills.

- Good working knowledge of financial analysis, budgeting, and forecasting.

- Effective written and verbal communication skills, including strong public speaking abilities.

- Strong working knowledge of various computer software such as Microsoft Office Suite, Microsoft Teams, JDEdwards, Salesforce; experience with Yardi is a plus.

- Ability to adapt to changing work environment.

- Completion of OSHA General Industries 30-Hour course preferred.

- Industry designation from a reputable industry organization such as ICSC, BOMA, or IREM is a plus.
